run_arguments.note: Operator label is ground truth metadata; it is not supplied as an input to the classifier.

limits: Configuration note declares volume100/fixed metronome page/stopped metronome. Exact repetitions/order not separately reconfirmed; group comparison assumes prescribed three stimuli.
No raw DMA0 spectral frames are saved; model spectra have N=1024.
Pure-tone nearest note B4/B5 is expected for 500/1000 Hz, not evidence of wrong note.
UI timing is software rendering, not LCD pixel refresh or touch end-to-end latency.
Unlabeled synthetic stimuli do not establish instrument classification accuracy.
